arguments.name: compression
arguments.text: If true, drop a trailing .gz, .bz2, or .xz before the extension.

origin.details: Only a trailing alphanumeric extension is removed. .hidden and file.c++ stay unchanged. foo/bar.txt.bak becomes foo/bar.txt.

arguments.name: compression
arguments.text: If true, drop a trailing .gz, .bz2, or .xz before the extension.

translation.details: The character class is libc iswalnum, the same class as file_ext. A compression suffix is removed first when compression is true.
translation.value: A string, or a list of strings. NA stays NA.
translation.example:
from tools import file_path_sans_ext
print(file_path_sans_ext(["file.tar.gz", ".hidden", "file.c++", "a.é"]))
print(file_path_sans_ext("file.tar.gz", compression=True))
